schemaDocumentation.pathModel: excludedProductionGlobs removes mock/testing contracts from production denominators; allowedNonProductionGlobs independently keeps those paths discoverable, classified, and separately reported. interfaces/*.vyi is classified as interface and scanned for cadence identifiers.
schemaDocumentation.cadenceCoverage: Discovery scans the declared roots and .json/.md/.py/.vy/.vyi suffixes. Reviewed patterns cover uppercase snake-case singular/plural BLOCK, lower-camel plural Blocks, per-block comments, known cadence aliases, and quoted dictionary keys ending in block(s), timelock, interval, duration, delay, expiry, or expiration, including those exact bare keys.
schemaDocumentation.historicalExclusions: migration_history/base-mainnet/** is an immutable duplicate of deployed Base sources and is deliberately excluded. Other present or future migration_history namespaces are scanned by default, including a future Robinhood deployment namespace. README.md is scanned for cadence prose.
schemaDocumentation.functionAttribution: Stable keys use a deterministic top-level def scan. Indented interface declarations and module-level code are attributed to <module>; this is not a full language AST and diagnostics should be read with that caveat.
schemaDocumentation.reviewAuthorities: BN, TS, seconds-unit, mixed-clock, and non-CAD cadence records use protocol/security; CAD-001 uses risk/oracle; path-boundary mechanics use engineering/tooling and production-boundary moves still require protocol/security review.
schemaDocumentation.reviewProvenance: Track 3-reviewed BN, TS, and CAD-001 records retain c304004 provenance. Non-CAD cadence, seconds-unit, mixed-clock, and path records cite the content-fingerprinted owner-approval attestation commit.
